normative_extracts.quote: Transitions are selected in document order starting from the innermost active atomic states; exiting a parent state exits all active descendant states.
An actor is a self-contained entity with its own private state that communicates with other actors exclusively by sending and receiving asynchronous events.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Resolves events from deepest active child states up to ancestor states, exiting active subtrees and stopping spawned actors before entering target states.

production_failures.symptom: User cancels multi-step upload wizard, yet Step 2 chunked upload continues consuming bandwidth
production_failures.root_cause: Parent transition to 'cancelled' did not invoke the child upload actor's AbortController cleanup on exit.
production_failures.mitigation: Invoke async uploads as child actors scoped to the 'uploading' state so SCXML exit rules cancel the actor automatically.

production_failures.symptom: Main thread freezes with maximum call stack exceeded on form validation
production_failures.root_cause: Eventless 'always' transition oscillates between 'validating' and 'invalid' because the guard mutates context on every microstep.
production_failures.mitigation: Gate automatic transitions on explicit user events or immutable guard predicates that cannot re-fire in the same macrostep.
